text: Right. actually some of the disguise stuff is there, just not ported over entirely yet. check here @cart/scape3d/ since this is where a good part of game logic still resides we will port over
resolution: Audited cart/scape3d/ per the user's correction that the disguise/systemic depth already exists (awaiting port). Found a complete, sophisticated crime-sim contract in cart/scape3d/design.ts plus partial live implementation in state/ + systems/ — MORE systemic than Hitman, so my prior 'missing verbs' list was wrong. Key systems catalogued: (1) Suspicion = 5-axis evidence vector (visual/fund/pattern/digital/location, 0..100) -> notoriety (player.ts: zeroSuspicion/computeNotoriety/adjustSuspicionAxis live; world.ts wires witnessed kills -> visual heat). (2) Disguise = VisualSignature (silhouette/color/accessory) as the unit of recognition; player.body.costume + setCostume live; witnesses store sawSignature w/ certainty; costumes burnable; Hazard.armedBySignature ties planted traps back to your look. (3) Interactions = universal verb system (instant/cast/qte, interruptible->witnessed) with effects kill/arm(trigger)/lure/disable/access/social/loot/stash — murder is just an effect; environmental kills are 'arm' interactions + Hazards (the systemic-not-authored model already in the contract). (4) MurderType = consequence profile (witnessRadius/loudness/discovery instant|delayed|hidden/per-axis evidence/style). (5) NPC = one identity x four projections (world body+appearance/tier/schedule/perception, framework/sim economic actor, dead-internet persona w/ accounts, UI face) + WitnessMemory; ActivationTier dormant(sim)/active(BT)/focal(LLM) = living-city LOD + soul personas. (6) Assets (safehouse/vehicle/business/launderer/mixer/fake_id) w/ upkeep + per-axis suspicion suppression = the roguelite cash<->freedom loop, deeper than Freelancer. (7) Zones amplify specific evidence axes (plaza->visual, darknet_cafe->digital). (8) Dead-internet websites + persistent InternetArtifacts (rumor/news_item/listing) where the investigation Case plays out publicly; crime-as-a-service app = a darknet marketplace surface. (9) HighState altered-state system (the opening 'high'). Conclusion: the work is PORT this spine onto the live 3D world (baked 508km2 city + no-V8 loader) + wire the job board, NOT invent depth. Offered to write a sequenced port plan (suspicion -> signature/witness -> interactions/murder -> schedules -> internet/Case). No code/files written; audit only.
